thread:
maya: Heads up — Azure marketplace invoice for March has a 38% spike tied to CloudEdge Partners' mid-month SKU override. Want to propose month-end smoothing rather than passing full spike to downstream resellers. TL;DR: request credit or amortize?
ajay: Can you paste the invoice line(s)/IDs? Also need to know if this was a pricing experiment or an ingestion error.
linh: I pulled the raw usage lines. snippet:
```
partner_id,sku,date,units,unit_price
CE-998,redwood-api-standard,2026-03-18,120000,0.012
CE-998,redwood-api-standard,2026-03-19,600000,0.0095  # override applied
```
The override shows on 3/19 and made month total jump ~38%.
finance-bot: Invoice digest: Invoice AZ-2026-03-31-789 | total_amount: $1,230,456 | unallocated_usage: 12.3% | flagged_lines: 1 (CE-998 override).
oliver: If this was a legitimate customer-initiated pricing override (partner discount), our options: 1) issue one-time partner credit; 2) amortize the delta across next 3 invoices (smoothing); 3) leave as-is. Preference for amortize if partner requests — reduces churn risk. Need finance approval + ops steps.
maya: @oliver +ajay can you estimate amortization GL entries and how it flows through RevRec? Also is there any SLA/contract language preventing smoothing?
ajay: Estimate: delta ~ $86k for March. Amortize across Apr/May/Jun -> ~$28.7k/mo. GL workflow: create contra-revenue line for March (-$86k) then recognize as deferred revenue over next 3 months. Need FP&A signoff.
linh: Also need legal check: partner contract clause 4.2 allows one-off discounts with written consent. We have an email thread from partner committing to the override (attached).
maya: Ok — action items:
- @ajay prepare estimate + accounting journal templates (due EOD)
- @oliver draft partner credit memo and proposed amortization schedule
- @legal loop in to confirm contract OK
I'll ping @channel if we need exec signoff.
oliver: :thumbsup: I'll start the memo. Suggest flagging in Console billing dashboard too so customer's billing UI shows amortized credit. Link to runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/billing-smoothing
finance-bot: Note: created ticket FIN-4829 for partner-credit workflow, assigned to @ajay.
maya: Thanks — one more thing: can we validate this wasn't double-counted during our ingestion jobs? @linh please run reconcile job 'azure-ingest-3' for partner CE-998 and paste job id.
linh: Running now. Job id: az-ingest-3-20260319-77
Result: one duplicate row found from legacy importer, but it accounts for only ~2% of delta. Main driver remains intentional override.
ajay: I'll upload the journal draft by 17:00. If FP&A approves, can we do smoothing effective on Apr invoices? Need ops lead to enable amortization flag before Apr close.
maya: Sounds good. Flagging for Apr close schedule. Thanks team.
